dialogue.content: こんにちは時間になりましたら始めさせていただきますね。今日はよろしくお願いいたいします。
dialogue.English: Hello. It's our scheduled time, so let's begin. I look forward to speaking with you today.

dialogue.content: よろしくおねがいします
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: はじめまして、相談員です。本日はどうぞよろしくお願いいたします。よろしければ、まず初めにご年齢と性別をお知らせいただけますか？
dialogue.English: Nice to meet you. I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in today. If you don't mind, could we start with your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 30歳 女性です
dialogue.English: I'm 30 years old and female.

dialogue.content: 大学卒業したいです
dialogue.English: I want to graduate from university.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 大学の卒業に関してご心配なんですね
dialogue.English: So you’re concerned about graduating from university, is that right?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: もう少し具体的に教えていただいてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me a little more about that?

dialogue.content: まだ入学はしていません
dialogue.English: I haven’t enrolled yet.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねこれから受験されるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. Are you planning to take entrance exams?

dialogue.content: これから資格取るために行きたいんです
dialogue.English: I want to go in order to get a qualification.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねこれから資格取得を目指されようとしているのですねそれは素晴らしいですね
dialogue.English: I see—you’re aiming to obtain a qualification. That’s wonderful.

dialogue.content: 受験の予定はいつ頃なのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: When are you planning to take the entrance exam?

dialogue.content: 早くて秋位です
dialogue.English: This autumn at the earliest.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねでは受験に対する不安もありますか？
dialogue.English: I see. So, do you also feel anxious about the entrance exam?

dialogue.content: お金と生活です
dialogue.English: It's about money and my daily life.

dialogue.content: 子供が2人います
dialogue.English: I have two children.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねそれは不安ですね
dialogue.English: I see. That must be a concern.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: しかもシングルで
dialogue.English: And I’m a single mother.

dialogue.content: ええ、それは心配にもなりますよね
dialogue.English: Yes, I can see why that would be worrisome.

dialogue.content: 今はお仕事をされているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Are you working at the moment?

dialogue.content: しています
dialogue.English: Yes, I am.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねただでさえお仕事をしながら子育てをされていて、さらに新たに資格取得を目指そうとされているんですねそれは不安にもなりますよね
dialogue.English: I see. It's already a lot to raise children while working, and on top of that, you're aiming to get a new qualification. It's completely understandable that you'd feel anxious.

dialogue.content: 大学は昼間行かれる予定でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Are you planning to attend daytime classes?

dialogue.content: ただいつまでもこの状態だと生活も苦しいと思うし
dialogue.English: But I feel like if things stay as they are, life will always be a struggle.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: そうですね…夜間はまだ考えた事なかったです
dialogue.English: That's true... I hadn't considered night classes yet.

dialogue.content: お金どうしようばかりで
dialogue.English: I've just been worrying about what to do about money.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: どこか補助金とか
dialogue.English: Like, if there are any subsidies or anything.

dialogue.content: ええ、補助金などを利用しながら通われる予定でしたか？
dialogue.English: Yes, were you planning to attend using subsidies or other aid?

dialogue.content: 行きたい学校が建築学科なんです
dialogue.English: The school I want to go to has an architecture department.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねでは、今のお仕事はどうされる予定でいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: I see. And what are your plans for your current job?

dialogue.content: 貯金があるので
dialogue.English: I have savings.

dialogue.content: 後、今の所は辞めようと思います
dialogue.English: And, I'm thinking of quitting my current job.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねとても大きな決断で資格取得を目指そうとされているんですね
dialogue.English: I see. You're making a very big decision to pursue this qualification.

dialogue.content: とても勇気のいることで、不安になるのも無理はないかと思います
dialogue.English: It takes a lot of courage, and it's perfectly natural to feel anxious.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 子供は小さいですが、
dialogue.English: My children are young, but...

dialogue.content: そうなんですねお子さまはおいくつなんですか？
dialogue.English: I see. How old are your children?

dialogue.content: 小学生です
dialogue.English: They’re in elementary school.

dialogue.content: お二人とも小学生なんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Are they both in elementary school?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 両親が元気な内に、子供を面倒みてもらいながら行けるのは今のうちかと
dialogue.English: I figured that now is the best time to go, while my parents are still healthy and can help look after the children.

dialogue.content: そうですかただでさえおひとりで小学生のお子さまを二人育てることも大変かと思いますが、さらに資格取得のために勉強しようということに頭が下がる思いがします
dialogue.English: I see. It must be very challenging to raise two elementary school children on your own, and I'm truly impressed that you're aiming to study for a qualification on top of that.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: では、今のご心配は受験というよりは、大学を卒業するまで頑張れるかということでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So at the moment, your concern is less about the entrance exam and more about whether you can keep going until you graduate. Is that right?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 後、給付金制度とか知りたくて
dialogue.English: And, I'd also like to know about grant programs.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: まずはもう少し具体的に状況をお聞きしてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: First, may I ask a bit more about your situation?

dialogue.content: 貯金はあるけど、万が一の為にできるだけ残したいし、
dialogue.English: I have savings, but I want to keep as much as possible for emergencies...

dialogue.content: そうですねごもっともなお考えだと思います
dialogue.English: Yes, I think that's a very reasonable way to think.

dialogue.content: 公的な支援の方が金利が安いと思ったので
dialogue.English: I thought public support would have lower interest rates.

dialogue.content: どこか窓口等ご存知ないかと
dialogue.English: I was wondering if you knew of any offices I could go to.

dialogue.content: そうですね窓口としては自治体や国の支援もあるかと思いますが、これまでご自身でどこかに相談されたことはありますか？
dialogue.English: I see. There should be support available from municipal and national governments. Have you consulted with anyone about this yourself so far?

dialogue.content: まだです
dialogue.English: Not yet.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 何か馬鹿にされないかって思って
dialogue.English: I was worried I would be looked down upon.

dialogue.content: そんな風にお感じになられているのですね
dialogue.English: So that’s how you’ve been feeling.

dialogue.content: シングルマザーで子供小さいのに、大学なんてとか
dialogue.English: Like, ‘You’re a single mother with small children—university, really?’

dialogue.content: 反対されるのではないかと
dialogue.English: I was afraid people would be against it.

dialogue.content: そんなお金があるなら、子供の為に貯金しなさいとか
dialogue.English: Or, ‘If you have that kind of money, save it for your children.’

dialogue.content: そうなんですねそんな風に思われるんですねとても立派なことでそんな風に考え必要はないと思いますが
dialogue.English: I see, so that's what you were afraid of. I think what you're doing is very admirable, and you don't need to think that way.

dialogue.content: そうですか?
dialogue.English: Do you think so?

dialogue.content: ええ、とても立派だと思います。そんな風に感じられる何か出来事があったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Yes, I think it's very admirable. Did something happen to make you feel that way?

dialogue.content: 身近な友人に言ったら、そう言われました
dialogue.English: When I told a close friend, that’s what they said.

dialogue.content: 現実見なさいって
dialogue.English: She told me to 'face reality.'

dialogue.content: そうなんですねそれはとても嫌な思いをされましたね
dialogue.English: I see. That must have been very hurtful.

dialogue.content: 子供を育てるのが先だろうって
dialogue.English: She said that raising my children should come first.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 夫とは死別なんです
dialogue.English: My husband passed away.

dialogue.content: 交通事故でなくなりました
dialogue.English: He died in a traffic accident.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねお子さまを思うからこそのお考えだと思いますが、そんな風に言われると、悲しくなりますね
dialogue.English: I see. I'm sure your friend said that out of concern for your children, but it must be sad to be told something like that.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねすみません、行違いましたね
dialogue.English: I see. I'm sorry, I misunderstood.

dialogue.content: いえ、大丈夫です
dialogue.English: No, it’s all right.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございますそれはとてもお辛い思いをしましたね
dialogue.English: Thank you. That must have been a very painful experience for you.

dialogue.content: 確かに現実厳しいかもしれません
dialogue.English: It's true that reality might be harsh.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そのうえで、それでもお子さまのために、資格取得をされようとお考えになったのですよね
dialogue.English: And on top of that, you still decided to pursue this qualification for your children's sake, didn't you?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 両親もお金の面を気にすると思うんです。
dialogue.English: I think my parents will be concerned about the financial side of things, too.

dialogue.content: わたしから見ると、とても立派で、現実をよく見ているからこそのお考えのように感じます
dialogue.English: From my perspective, it seems like a very admirable idea, one that comes from seeing reality very clearly.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: なので、給付金とか経済的にちゃんとした物があれば、説明できるかと思って。
dialogue.English: So, I thought if I had something concrete like a grant or some financial support, I'd be able to explain it to them.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうですね。貯金があるとのことでしたが、具体的に何年くらいは大丈夫かというような試算はされていますか？
dialogue.English: Yes, that makes sense. You mentioned you have savings; have you calculated specifically how many years you'd be okay for?

dialogue.content: どうでしょうか…
dialogue.English: I’m not sure...

dialogue.content: そうですね…。
dialogue.English: Let's see...

dialogue.content: 夫の遺産や色々整理して、大学通う4年間は大丈夫かなと
dialogue.English: After organizing my husband's estate and everything else, I think I should be okay for the four years of university.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: ギリギリですが
dialogue.English: It will be tight, though.

dialogue.content: すでにいろいろと整理もされて、試算もされているのですね大変な中、本当に素晴らしいと思います
dialogue.English: So you've already organized everything and made calculations. To do that while going through such a difficult time is truly wonderful.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: それでは、さらに公的な補助金もあればご両親も安心されるかもしれないですね
dialogue.English: In that case, having some additional public financial aid might help your parents feel more at ease, too.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 窓口についてなんですが、まずはやはりお住いの自治体にお問い合わせいただくのがいいかと思います
dialogue.English: Regarding where to ask, I think the best first step would be to inquire at your local municipal office.

dialogue.content: そうなるんですか
dialogue.English: Is that how it works?

dialogue.content: どの部署になるのでしょう?
dialogue.English: Which department would that be?

dialogue.content: 子供ではないし
dialogue.English: Since it’s not about the children.

dialogue.content: そうですね場合によっては国の窓口を紹介されることもあるかと思いますが、まずはお住いの自治体かと思います
dialogue.English: That's right. They may refer you to a national service depending on the situation, but I believe your local municipality is the first place to go.

dialogue.content: なるほど。そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see. Okay.

dialogue.content: 部署は自治体によって違いますので、ネットで自治体の「ひとり親支援」をお調べになるか、代表の電話番号に電話して窓口へつなげていただく方法もあると思います。
dialogue.English: The department differs by municipality, so you could search online for your city’s ‘support for single parents,’ or call the main switchboard and ask to be connected to the right desk.

dialogue.content: そういうのがあるんですか
dialogue.English: They have something like that?

dialogue.content: 知らなかったです
dialogue.English: I didn't know.

dialogue.content: はい、ひとり親やシングルマザーの就労支援、または資格取得の支援があると思います
dialogue.English: Yes, there should be employment support or qualification acquisition support for single parents or single mothers.

dialogue.content: 給付金とか奨学金は知ってたけど
dialogue.English: I knew about grants and scholarships, but...

dialogue.content: なんか心強いですね
dialogue.English: That's very reassuring.

dialogue.content: 聞いて良かったです
dialogue.English: I’m glad I asked.

dialogue.content: 友達にも馬鹿にされたから
dialogue.English: Because my friend made fun of me.

dialogue.content: ええ、お辛い思いをされましたね
dialogue.English: Yes, you had a painful experience.

dialogue.content: 親にも色々言われるんじゃないかって心配でした
dialogue.English: I was worried my parents would say all sorts of things, too.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 誰からも理解されない中でも、あきらめずにご相談にいらしてくださり、ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you for not giving up and coming to consult with me, even when you felt no one understood.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございます。世間ってシングルマザーに冷たいと思う事が多くて
dialogue.English: No, thank you. I often feel that society is cold towards single mothers.

dialogue.content: 夫がなくなってから、手のひら返しみたいな事もあったり
dialogue.English: After my husband passed away, some people completely changed how they treated me.

dialogue.content: ええそうなんですね　とても辛い思いをされてきたのですね
dialogue.English: Yes, I see. You've been through so many painful experiences.

dialogue.content: 人が去っていった事も割と多かったので
dialogue.English: Quite a lot of people just left my life.

dialogue.content: 辛かったです
dialogue.English: It was hard.

dialogue.content: ええ、お辛い気持ちが痛いほど伝わります
dialogue.English: Yes, I can feel how painful that must have been.

dialogue.content: でも、こういう窓口があるのを最近知って
dialogue.English: But I recently found out that places like this exist.

dialogue.content: それで初めて相談にきました
dialogue.English: And that's why I came for a consultation for the first time.

dialogue.content: それでも、先のことを考えられてきたのですねそれは本当に勇気がいることですし、逆境に負けない強さをお持ちなんですね
dialogue.English: And yet, you've still been able to think about the future. That takes real courage, and it shows you have the strength to not give in to adversity.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: なんか頑張れそうです
dialogue.English: I feel like I can keep going.

dialogue.content: ご相談にきてくださったことを本当にうれしく思います自治体の窓口に相談することもご心配のようでしたが、今はいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I’m truly glad you came to speak with me today. You mentioned feeling anxious about contacting the municipal office—how do you feel about it now?

dialogue.content: やってみます
dialogue.English: I’ll give it a try.

dialogue.content: そうですか良かったです
dialogue.English: I’m glad to hear that.

dialogue.content: 他にご心配なことなどありますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything else you’re concerned about?

dialogue.content: 馬鹿にする人ばかりじゃない事がわかったから
dialogue.English: I've learned that not everyone will look down on me.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 後は…また何かあれば相談に来ます
dialogue.English: Other than that... I’ll come back if something else comes up.

dialogue.content: はいいつでもいらしてくださいこれまで、本当によく頑張られてきましたね
dialogue.English: Yes, please come back anytime. You've really been doing so well through all of this.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 理解者がなく辛いことの多い中、それでもお子さまのために、現実を見て新しいことにチャレンジしようとされる姿勢は、尊敬に値するものだとわたしは思います。
dialogue.English: Even with few people to understand you and while facing many hardships, your attitude of looking at reality and trying to take on a new challenge for your children's sake is, in my opinion, worthy of respect.

dialogue.content: そんな、高尚なものでもないです。
dialogue.English: Oh, it's nothing that noble.

dialogue.content: 私自身の為かもしれません。
dialogue.English: It might be for my own sake, too.

dialogue.content: それでも、反対が多い中でもあきらめずに自分の道を進もうとされた強さをお持ちです。
dialogue.English: Even so, you have the strength to try and follow your own path without giving up, even when facing a lot of opposition.

dialogue.content: 一時目指していた物を諦めて、夫と結婚したので
dialogue.English: I gave up on what I was aiming for once to marry my husband.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: なんか色々褒めてもらって気恥ずかしいです。
dialogue.English: It’s a little embarrassing to be praised so much.

dialogue.content: それでは、あらためてまたご自身の人生を自分で切り開こうとされているのですね。
dialogue.English: In that case, you are once again trying to forge your own path in life.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その勇気があればきっと、目標を達成することもできると思います。
dialogue.English: With that courage, I believe you can achieve your goals.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: すいません。そろそろ用事があるので、この辺で。
dialogue.English: Excuse me. I have to go soon, so I'll wrap things up here.

dialogue.content: はい、そろそろお時間となりますので、終了させていただきますね。またいつでもいらしてください
dialogue.English: Yes, it is about time, so we'll end the session here. Please feel free to come back anytime.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 今日はありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you as well.

dialogue.content: （お疲れ様でした。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your time.)

dialogue.content: (終了🆗です)
dialogue.English: (Okay to end.)

dialogue.content: （これで本日のロープレを終了させていただきます。忌憚ない評価のほど、よろしくお願いいたします。）
dialogue.English: (This concludes today's role-play session. I look forward to your frank evaluation.)
